svg.title: Surfari Knox Test Coverage Matrix
svg.desc: Data-backed 50 by 50 heatmap with 400 covered cells and weighted depth 936.
svg.text: EID-448 planned proof ladder for governed browser workflows
50 ordered tests x 50 ordered capabilities. 400/2500 cells covered (16.0%). Weighted depth 936/10000 (9.4%). Average 8.0, max 50.
